apiary-dashboard.name: admin
apiary-dashboard.description: #1013: composite of 'access' so an admin-only grant (kcadm, a future provisioning script, a realm edit) can't lock a user out of dashboard auth, which hard-requires 'access' before it even looks at admin/user distinction

apiary-dashboard-rewrite.name: admin
apiary-dashboard-rewrite.description: #3578: same shape as apiary-dashboard's admin (composite of 'access'), for the rewrite dashboard, which reads resource_access.apiary-dashboard-rewrite.roles and treats anyone without 'admin' as a viewer

traefik-dashboard.name: admin
traefik-dashboard.description: #1014: distinctly named (not 'access') because this grants root-equivalent control of the homeserver's reverse proxy -- must never be conflated with the ordinary low-privilege 'access' role used by Kibana/EveBox/Arkime/TANNER/RevDeck

arcane.name: admin
arcane.description: #1014/#1185: distinctly named (not 'access') -- Arcane has /var/run/docker.sock mounted read-write, root-equivalent control of the homeserver. Never conflate with the low-privilege 'access' role. Mapped via OIDC_ROLE_MAPPINGS.

clients.name: APIARY dashboard (rewrite)
clients.description: #3578: the rewrite dashboard's own client, with two redirect origins (production and beta). Roles access/admin are mapped as for apiary-dashboard.

clients.name: Arcane (native OIDC, #1185)
clients.description: #1185: unlike every other client above, Arcane authenticates directly against this client -- no oauth2-proxy gateway in front of it. frontchannelLogout is false: no gateway session to tear down, only Arcane's own.

clients.name: Auth-failure telemetry poller (#1066)
clients.description: Read-only poller for #1066's auth-failure telemetry. Granted view-events post-import -- see keycloak/provision-events-poller.sh.

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token
